profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is listed in company records as a for-profit public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, trading under the ticker ALNT with CIK 0000046129. The text harvested from its website, at alantra.com, describes Alantra, which it calls an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. That text says the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and describes a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while operating with autonomy and being personally invested in the firm.

The record lists no AI products and no MCP servers for the company, so there is no tracked AI offering to describe. Its law exposure is recorded for New York with a count of 458, and no individual cases are named.

The name on the company record, Allient Inc, differs from the name used in the harvested site text, Alantra.
